name: Lotta

skills.name: Heartfelt Confession
skills.description: Selects 1 enemy target within 6 tiles and deals Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to them.

skills.name: Cryo Rounds
skills.description: Selects 1 direction around self, deal AoE Freeze damage equal to 60% of attack to all enemy targets within a 3x5 area in the chosen direction. Simultaneously, destroy any destructible Cover outside a 3x3 area within range around self. Additionally, applies Cold Snap to targets for 1 turn.

skills.name: Neural Adjustment
skills.description: Fills Confectance Index and gains Attack Up I for 2 turns.

skills.name: Amplified Courage
skills.description: Select 1 enemy target within 6 tiles of the user to launch an attack, dealing AoE Freeze damage equal to 100% of attack to it and all enemy targets within 3 tiles that ignores Cover damage reduction. If it hits 2 or more targets, gains Extra Command.

skills.name: Bonds of Friendship
skills.description: When an enemy target within range is affected by Cold Snap, performs 1 instance of Wise Support, dealing AoE Physical damage equal to 50% of attack and 1 point of Stability Damage to them. This can be triggered up to 2 times per turn.

fortification.effect: If Phase Weakness is exploited, apply Cold Snap to the target for 1 turn.
Increases mobility of self by 1 point.
Stability damage dealt by Wise Support increases by 1 point.
Increases the duration of Cold Snap by 1 turn.
Replaces Attack Up I with Attack Up II.

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Silent Cheer
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, gain 3 points of Confectance Index.

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Confidence Booster
keys.effect: Increases damage dealt to enemy targets with Freeze type debuffs by 10%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Trembling Aim
keys.effect: If Freeze damage is dealt, applies Frozen to the target for 2 turns.

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Careful Evasion
keys.effect: When Hp is greater than 50%, reduces AoE damage taken by 20%.

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Bold Shout
keys.effect: Add a new effect to the active skill Cryo Rounds. Knock back the target by 3 tiles.

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Soothing Touch
keys.effect: The active skill Neural Adjustment gains a new effect: Gains 1 stack of Quick Barrier.

keys.name: Common Key - Hunting Trap
keys.effect: ATK +3.0% / Increases damage dealt against enemy targets with movement debuffs by 7%.

keys.name: Expansion Key
keys.effect: Before attacking, if the target's Stability is more than 0, increases damage dealt by 10%
